enabled.label: Inject scripts on public pages
enabled.description: Master switch. Turn it off to stop every script below without deleting them.

plausibleSrc.label: Plausible: script URL
plausibleSrc.description: The script URL from your Plausible site, for example https://plausible.io/js/pa-XXXX.js or the same path on your self-hosted domain. A pa-XXXX.js URL is loaded together with its init call, so nothing else is needed. For the older script.js format, also fill in the domain below. Leave empty to use https://plausible.io/js/script.js when only a domain is set.

plausibleDomain.label: Plausible: site domain (older script format only)
plausibleDomain.description: For example emdashhq.com. Not used with a pa-XXXX.js script URL.

cloudflareBeaconToken.label: Cloudflare Web Analytics: token
cloudflareBeaconToken.description: The token from Cloudflare, Web Analytics, your site. Leave empty to disable.

gaMeasurementId.label: Google Analytics 4: measurement ID
gaMeasurementId.description: For example G-XXXXXXXXXX. Leave empty to disable.

headHtml.label: Custom HTML in <head>
headHtml.description: Raw HTML inserted as written: script tags, link tags, meta tags (site verification, fonts, preconnect).

bodyStartHtml.label: Custom HTML at the start of <body>
bodyStartHtml.description: For example a Google Tag Manager noscript iframe.

bodyEndHtml.label: Custom HTML at the end of <body>
bodyEndHtml.description: Chat widgets, deferred scripts, anything that should load last.
